description_en: Deletes custom images. If you no longer require a custom image, you can call this operation to delete the custom image. You can also call this operation to delete multiple custom images at the same time. After a custom image is deleted, you cannot use the custom image to reset the simple application servers that were created based on the custom image
description_zh: 如果您不再需要某些自定义镜像，可以将其批量删除。自定义镜像被删除后，使用该镜像创建的轻量应用服务器将无法使用该镜像重置系统
name: DeleteCustomImages

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom image. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 15 image IDs. Separate multiple image IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的镜像ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持15个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: image_ids

parameters.help_en: The client token that you want to use to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
